contract.metadataSource: Existing frozen V3 COIN-M contract specification; contractSize is 100 USD.

dataSource: Binance Vision official COIN-M monthly archives

assumptions.signalTiming: T-1 fully closed daily index close -> T first execution bar open
assumptions.orderLifecycle: cancel-and-replace each UTC day; unfilled maker orders expire at day end
assumptions.riskReduction: risk reduction and short covering are immediate taker trades
assumptions.pathModel: OHLC path: open -> low -> high -> close on bullish bars; open -> high -> low -> close on bearish bars
assumptions.funding: official Binance Vision fundingRate records; unavailable history remains missing/partial, never imputed as zero
assumptions.oosParameterFreeze: All scenario thresholds/bonuses are defined before running OOS; no OOS selection or retuning.

funding.source: Binance Vision COIN-M monthly fundingRate archives
